snippet.title: Barbie Rewind - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In Barbie™️ Rewind, your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the years. Barbie has also left you her game collection, featuring Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007, enhanced to be accessible on today’s consoles. 

Wishlist and Pre-Order Today: https://atari.com/products/barbie-rewind-game-doll

Join the Atari Discord: https://link.atari.com/atariclubdiscord
